sentences.en: If I get stopped and it gets tricky and, you know, if I'm traveling with my kids or whatnot

sentences.zh: 或者我觉得它占用了陪伴的时间。
不过说实话，这种情况很少见。

sentences.en: And I mean, I still get to ride my skateboard for a living.
sentences.zh: 而且我是说，我依然能靠滑滑板谋生。

sentences.en: I get paid to talk about skateboarding.
Like, it's just such a dream come true.
sentences.zh: 就像是，梦想成真了一样。

sentences.en: And I can't believe I still get to do it.
sentences.zh: 而且我真不敢相信我到现在还能做这个。

sentences.en: And, you know, I'm not some, I don't think I'm some polarizing figure.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，我不是那种……我不觉得自己是个备受争议的人物。

sentences.en: So people are generally very nice and happy when I, when they see me.
sentences.zh: 所以人们通常都非常友善，看到我时都很高兴。

sentences.en: And our video game series was a huge hit.
sentences.zh: 我们的电子游戏系列大获成功。

sentences.zh: 所有乒乓球都落地了吗？

sentences.zh: 我学了几年，高中毕业后又在法国呆了大约六周。

sentences.en: So I understand it more than I speak it.
sentences.zh: 所以我听懂的比说得要多。

sentences.en: Like we were there for the Olympics over the summer.
sentences.zh: 比如夏天我们在那里看奥运会。

sentences.en: I managed to navigate our family through some tricky security checkpoints thanks to my French.
sentences.zh: 多亏了我的法语，我成功带家人通过了一些棘手的安检关卡。

sentences.en: So I feel like that was worth all the two years of it in school.
sentences.zh: 所以我感觉这没白费我在学校学的那两年。

sentences.zh: 我 12 岁时，我的音乐老师希望我参加这些课外学校音乐会之类的活动

sentences.zh: 而那正好是我要去比赛的时候。

sentences.zh: 我告诉他不行，我得去，我要去参加滑板比赛。

sentences.zh: 他说，那两样你不能兼得。

sentences.en: You had to pick violin or skateboarding.
sentences.zh: 你必须在小提琴和滑板之间二选一。

sentences.en: That was a real sliding doors moment.
sentences.zh: 那真是一个命运转折的瞬间。

sentences.en: And I said, okay, well, I, this is way more fun for me.
sentences.zh: 我说，好吧，我觉得这个对我有意思得多。

sentences.en: And I didn't think I was choosing a future anyway.
sentences.zh: 而且我当时也没想过是在选择未来。

sentences.en: I'm not going to be a concert violinist or I'm not going to be a pro skateboard.
sentences.zh: 我又不会成为音乐会小提琴家，也不会成为职业滑板手。

sentences.en: I'm just, I just love doing this.
sentences.zh: 我只是，我就是喜欢做这个。

sentences.en: And so, and so I chose, and I wish that I hadn't quit.
sentences.zh: 所以，所以我就做了选择，但我也希望当时没有放弃。

sentences.zh: 不让我继续留在他的班里。

sentences.en: Because I wasn't doing the other stuff.
sentences.zh: 因为我没有做那些别的事。

sentences.en: I tried to pick it up again and it wasn't like riding a bike.
sentences.zh: 我试图重新捡起它，但这可不是一学就会、永生难忘的。

sentences.zh: 你曾经去过哪个地方，是你绝对深爱的？

sentences.zh: 我14岁时去过那里，为了一个基本上叫作“奇迹小子”或“神奇儿童”的电视节目。

sentences.en: And in my later years, Iceland.
sentences.zh: 后来大一点的时候，是冰岛。

sentences.en: Oh, I'm going to Iceland this summer.
sentences.zh: 噢，我今年夏天要去冰岛。

sentences.zh: 我喜欢尽量待在家裡，以防这种事情发生。

Like a kettle corn kind of thing?
sentences.zh: 就像大锅爆米花那种的？
